title: Graph IR v1 schema, identifiers, and evidence
objective: Define and validate the minimal Graph IR v1 contract with stable identifiers, authority classes, provenance, evidence, and cross-record invariants without viewer-library concepts.
validations: Ajv compiled the Graph IR v1 JSON Schema 2020-12 document in strict mode
minimal Graph IR v1 fixture passed schema and semantic validation
6 Node tests passed for evidence, references, canonical IDs, uniqueness, ordering, and path traversal
TypeScript checks passed for x6-canvas, graph-x6, and architecture-studio
coordination validation and control-plane audit passed with 8 tasks before completion
Graph IR candidate generation and freshness checks passed with 24 nodes and 19 edges before completion
viewer-boundary scan found no X6, DOM, viewport, layout, or color concepts in the v1 schema
all Graph IR JSON documents parsed and git diff whitespace check passed
dependency audit found no Ajv advisory; 17 pre-existing Vite/Nx-path advisories were recorded in SECURITY-001
risks: A broad v1 schema could freeze speculative concepts before extractors have real evidence.
Embedding X6, DOM, layout, or application presentation fields would violate DEC-050.
Schema validation alone cannot enforce unique IDs, ordering, or referential integrity; semantic validation must remain deterministic and adjacent.
The workspace audit reports 6 high and 11 moderate advisories through Vite and Nx dependencies; Ajv is not affected and remediation is separately owned by SECURITY-001.
